caption: The drawing depicts a round, tan-colored stoneware jar with two small looped handles on either side, one on the left and one on the right, decorated with blue accents on the handles, rim, and base. The jar features the inscription "COERLEARS HOOK" in blue, capital letters near the rim. In the center of the jar's body, there is a large blue floral motif consisting of a stylized blossom with leaves and a curving stem. Above the jar and to the right, there is a rectangular, scroll-like label bordered in blue with the words "N. YORK" in uppercase blue letters. In the bottom left corner, a close-up square showcases the same floral motif in blue. The name "JOHN DANA" is written in small, grey text at the bottom right of the drawing. The composition is rendered in watercolor and ink on a cream-colored background.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
